title: Pikmin Started With 128 Marios and Ants in Miyamoto's Garden
hook: Pikmin began with a GameCube demo of 128 Marios on screen, and Miyamoto says ants in his garden did the rest. This week he declared November 1 Pikmin Day. Which Pikmin type would you send in first?
script: Did you know Pikmin grew out of a GameCube tech demo called Mario one twenty eight? In August 2000, Nintendo unveiled the GameCube at Space World with a demo called Mario one twenty eight. It showed a crowd of Marios running around at once, just to prove what the new console could handle. Years later, Shigeru Miyamoto told a room full of developers that most of them had already played Mario one twenty eight. It lived on in Pikmin, he said, and later in Super Mario Galaxy. Miyamoto has also said the idea came to him while watching ants in his garden, though he admits the real story is more complicated. The first Pikmin launched on the GameCube in Japan on October 26, 2001. That means the series just turned 25 years old. That first game gave you only 30 in-game days to finish, and Nintendo removed the limit in Pikmin 2. Pikmin 4 became the best seller in the series, passing 3.4 million copies by Nintendo's own count. And this week Miyamoto declared November 1st Pikmin Day, with a free Pikmin 4 demo arriving on Switch 2 today. Three Pikmin standing together look like the number one, which is the whole reason for the date. Which Pikmin type would you send in first? Follow for more gaming history.
